page_title: FIO 0-1 JUV | Fiorentina v Juventus 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) is flagged for offside again due to his bad timing. The defence is playing cleverly and, not for the first time today, laidset the offside trap.
90+5' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a long ball in, but Wojciech Szczesny comfortably gathers the ball.
90+4' Weston McKennie (Juventus) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Weston McKennie (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+4' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+3' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
90+2' Juventus take a short corner kick.

90+2' Pietro Terracciano pulls off a fantastic save! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Luca Ranieri makes his way off the pitch and Yerry Mina (Fiorentina) comes on as his replacement.
89' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
88' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.

87' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
83' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Daniele Chiffi lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
82' Flag goes up against Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
78' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
78' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) replacing Christian Kouame.
78' That's the end of the game for Arthur Melo, who is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
77' The statistic for corner kicks – 9:0.
76' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

74' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Wojciech Szczesny pulls off an easy save.
74' Poor challenge! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle.

73' The cross into the penalty area from Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
72' This shall not pass! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
71' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
70' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
68' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Federico Chiesa is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
68' It is time for a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is on for Moise Kean.
67' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
66' A pass into the penalty area from Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is intercepted by the defence.
65' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
65' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
65' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
64' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post.
63' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
62' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
62' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Fiorentina players are visibly unhappy with the call.
61' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).

60' Play continues despite the shouts by some Fiorentina players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
60' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
59' Today's match ends for Antonin Barak who will be replaced by Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina).
58' Federico Gatti (Juventus) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
55' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
54' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Filip Kostic (Juventus). Daniele Chiffi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
51' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
51' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

51' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Pietro Terracciano makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
48' Moise Kean (Juventus) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. M'Bala Nzola has come on in place of Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
45+2' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Wojciech Szczesny to dive and make a save.
44' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
44' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
43' What was Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
43' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
42' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
40' Fiorentina take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

40' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' The foul by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
37' The ball possession is 68:32.
36' The resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

36' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.

31' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.

29' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
29' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Wojciech Szczesny punches the ball away.
29' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

28' The game is interrupted. Filip Kostic (Juventus) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
26' Filip Kostic (Juventus) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
25' Daniele Chiffi blows the whistle, Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Juventus are awarded the free kick.
23' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
22' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
20' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Fiorentina earn a corner.
20' Filip Kostic (Juventus) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Fiorentina earn a free kick.
19' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) produces a cunning chipped pass for Lucas Beltran, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
18' A lofted cross from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
15' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
15' Bremer (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
13' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
12' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina).
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Filip Kostic produces a great pass that finds Fabio Miretti (Juventus) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
8' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) squanders a big chance! The ball rebounded out to him and he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post.
8' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
7' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle after Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
4' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
